supports_model.mismatch_notes: SP-125 (the registry's local source) prints Nu = C1 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4 (mu/mu_w)^0.14 with a coolant-specific C1 (RP-1: 0.0214, PDF p.119). The code and registry use 0.027 Re^0.8 Pr^(1/3) (mu_b/mu_w)^0.14 (the classical Sieder & Tate 1936 form, which is not held in the corpus). Same structure and viscosity correction; different coefficient and Prandtl exponent. Relative to the SP-125 RP-1 form the code's h_c is higher by about 26% at Pr = 1, 17% at Pr = 3 and 7% at Pr = 11.7 (RP-1 at 600 R).
